name: Folklore Clinical Variant Interpretation MCP
description: Open-source public MCP adapter for Folklore by Helena Bioinformatics. It helps agents classify supported GRCh38 germline variants under ACMG/AMP using structured public evidence, provenance and linked literature. The hosted server is read-only, requires no account or API key, accepts no patient or private case data, and is not a diagnosis or treatment recommendation.

owner.name: Helena Bioinformatics
owner.description: Bulgarian bioinformatics company building free, source-linked scientific infrastructure for researchers and qualified professionals.
